```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("patchwork")
library("scales")
library("nlme")

setwd("C:/Users/bwvma/OneDrive - ucsc.edu/One Drive Back Up/R-Studio/Octodata")
Octo <- read_csv("Octo Trials Data (Control, Octo, Octo treatment) 2 3.csv")
```

```{r}
library("extrafont")

theme_set(
  theme_classic(base_size = 18.46, base_family = "Calibri")
)
```


```{r}

  Graph_data_Top = Octo |> 
   filter(Treatment != "Octo Eating") |>
  select(Treatment,`Movement? 2`) |> 
    mutate(
    Treatment = recode(Treatment, "Control" = "Control", "Octo" = "Octopus Present"))|> 
    arrange(Treatment)

Graph_Top <- Graph_data_Top |> #sorted data in graph_data_1
  group_by(Treatment) |> 
  summarize(mean_chance_of_movement=mean(`Movement? 2`),
            SD=sd(`Movement? 2`),
            n=n(),
            SE=SD/sqrt(n)) |> 
  
  ggplot(aes(x = Treatment, 
             y = mean_chance_of_movement,
             fill=Treatment,
             )) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00"),
                    name = NULL)+ #changes legend title)+
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_chance_of_movement - SE,
      ymax = mean_chance_of_movement + SE
    ),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(mean_chance_of_movement*100),"%")),
            vjust = -0.5,
            hjust = -0.5
            ) +
  geom_text(x = 0.5, y = 0.65, label = "(a)") +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Probability of Movement (%)"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(NULL,NULL) #renames x axis labels
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous( 
    
    labels = scales::percent_format(), #formats y axis as percentages
    limits = c(0, 0.70), # set limit of y axis
    expand = c(0, 0) # removes space between bar and x axis
  ) +
    
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(color = alpha("gray", 0.5), #alpha value of line
                                          linewidth = 0.5),
          panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = alpha("gray", 0.3),
                                          linewidth = 0.25)
)
  

Graph_Top #shows graph below
```
```{r}
Graph_data_Bottom = Octo |> 
  filter(Treatment != "Octo Eating") |> 
  select(`Distance (cm)`,`Treatment`) |>
  mutate(
    Treatment = recode(Treatment, "Control" = "Control", "Octo" = "Octopus Present")
      
  )

Graph_Bottom <- Graph_data_Bottom |> #sorted data in graph_data_1
  group_by(Treatment) |> 
  summarize(mean_distance=mean(`Distance (cm)`),
            SD=sd(`Distance (cm)`),
            n=n(),
            SE=SD/sqrt(n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Treatment, 
             y = mean_distance,
             fill=Treatment,
             )) +
  geom_col() +
   scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00"),
                     name = NULL)+ #changes legend title
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_distance - SE,
      ymax = mean_distance + SE
    ),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(mean_distance,2)," cm")),
            vjust = -0.5,
            hjust = -0.5
            ) +
  
  geom_text(x = 0.5, y = 8.3, label = "(b)") +
  
  labs(
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "Mean Distance Moved (cm)",
    
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(NULL,NULL) #renames x axis labels
  ) +
  

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 9), #sets limit of y axis
    expand = c(0, 0) #removes space between bar and x axis
  )+
  
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(color = alpha("gray", 0.5), #alpha value of line
                                          linewidth = 0.5),
          panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = alpha("gray", 0.3),
                                          linewidth = 0.25)
)

Graph_Bottom #shows graph below

```
```{r}

Graph_2_Combined <- Graph_Top/Graph_Bottom + #patchwork
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
 theme(legend.position = "right") 


ggsave(Graph_2_Combined, filename="Calibri Graph 2 Lab Trials Treatment,movement Prob and distance.png",dpi=600, height=7, width=10)

Graph_2_Combined
```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)



Graph_Top_Stats_Data <-
  Graph_data_Top |>
  select(Treatment, `Movement? 2`) |> 
  mutate(ID = row_number()) #creates ID column for random effect)

  
  
 Graph_Top_Stats <- glmer(
  `Movement? 2` ~ Treatment + (1 | ID),
  data = Graph_Top_Stats_Data,
  family = binomial
)

anova(Graph_Top_Stats, type = 3)
summary(Graph_Top_Stats)
anova(Graph_Top_Stats)


Graph_data_Top

```
```{r}
Graph_Bottom_Stats_data <-
  Graph_data_Bottom |>
  select(Treatment, `Distance (cm)`) |> 
  mutate(`Log_distance_plus1` = log(`Distance (cm)`+1)) |> 
  mutate(ID = row_number()) #creates ID column for random effect)

 
Graph_Bottom_Stats <- lme(
   `Log_distance_plus1` ~ Treatment, random = ~1|ID, 
     data = Graph_Bottom_Stats_data)


anova(Graph_Bottom_Stats)

Graph_Bottom_Stats_data
```
